purpose: Product illustration assets, not QA screenshots or evidence
referenceAuthority: Supplied photographs. Prior F1–F3 character appearance was rejected, not approved.

prompts.taupe:
Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve. Production artwork for an articulated 2.5D storybook puppet, NOT a mockup or screenshot.
The attached photo is the ONLY identity reference: this exact beloved warm grey/taupe floppy-eared stuffed rabbit. Recreate its specific plush identity with rich, delicate hand-painted textile realism, subtle gouache edges, soft individual pile, gentle warm side light. It must look like this actual plush, not a bear, not a generic rabbit, not a Pixar character. Face is a broad softly flattened rounded oval, modest black bead eyes, small dusty pink nose tilted downward and a subtle dark central fur seam, no white muzzle, no exaggerated smile. Thick warm grey shaggy fur, not smooth short felt. Head slightly wider than tall. Ears exceptionally important: long, wide, heavy floppy ears falling from sides of head to below its chin, NOT upright and NOT tiny side bumps. Pink nose is NOT a tongue.
OUTPUT ONE SQUARE TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas, 2048 square if available, precisely 3 columns by 3 rows of equal cells, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text. Each part completely separated with wide transparent margins inside its own cell, centered. Every part straight frontal view, fully complete, no cropping. Parts in this exact order:
row 1 column1: HEAD ONLY including both original eyes and the nose, WITHOUT EARS, no neck/body. Full detailed shaggy oval head and cheek volumes.
row1 column2: TORSO ONLY, pear-shaped cuddly taupe body, no head/arms/feet, same pile.
row1 column3: LEFT LONG FLOPPY EAR only, from narrow rounded attachment at top to heavy rounded hanging tip at bottom, 3.3x longer than wide. Inner side darker same taupe fabric. Slight outward curve.
row2 column1: RIGHT LONG FLOPPY EAR only, same length and material with natural asymmetric outward curve, attachment top, tip bottom.
row2 column2: UPPER ARM SEGMENT only, plump furry hanging capsule, seamless round ends, vertical.
row2 column3: FOREARM SEGMENT only, plump furry hanging capsule with round ends, vertical.
row3 column1: LEFT PAW only, soft rounded stuffed paw, no claws or paw-pad symbols.
row3 column2: RIGHT PAW only.
row3 column3: ONE FOOT only, broad soft stuffed foot, front three-quarter view, same taupe fur, no claws or cartoon sole pads.
No assembled character, no props, no environment, no floor, no cast shadow outside the parts. Preserve true alpha. Parts must be high fidelity enough for mobile closeups. These parts will be articulated in code; do not depict joints/rods/hinges.
prompts.pink:
Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve. Production sprite artwork, not a webpage or screenshot. Attached photo is the primary and ONLY character identity reference: this exact small pale pink stuffed rabbit. Preserve plush likeness precisely in a fine hand-painted textile-realism style, tender original children's film artwork, soft pile with thousands of pale pink and ivory wisps, warm gentle side light. Avoid generic cartoon rabbit anatomy and synthetic flat shapes. The real rabbit has a substantial soft round head, small widely spaced glossy BLACK BEAD eyes, a broad matte pink nose, a large protruding IVORY MUZZLE with a subtle central pink stitched vertical mouth. NO drawn W smile. Pink torso not a big white bib. Ears very asymmetric: one long upright ear slants outward to viewer left, the OTHER is much shorter and plumper, flopping outward to viewer right like the photo, not two matching tall ears.
Create one SQUARE transparent PNG sprite atlas, ideally 2048px square, 3 columns by 3 rows of equal cells. Isolate every part completely with clear transparent gutters; no text, numbers, grid, ground or decorative backdrop. No assembled character. Order:
row1 col1: detailed HEAD ONLY with original bead eyes, pink nose and ivory muzzle; WITHOUT ears and neck.
row1 col2: soft pink TORSO ONLY, rounded seated plush pear shape, subtly lighter belly at bottom, no head/limbs and no invented large white chest patch.
row1 col3: LONG LEFT EAR ONLY, pale pink shaggy fur edge, pale ivory-pink inset fabric, attachment at bottom, rounded tip at top. Straight asset so we can angle it in code, length about three widths.
row2 col1: SHORT RIGHT EAR ONLY, plump short soft folded petal shape with light pink inset, attachment bottom, rounded tip top, about 1.6x longer than wide; this is the distinctive stubby folded ear in the photograph.
row2 col2: UPPER ARM SEGMENT ONLY, furry soft capsule with rounded ends, hanging vertical.
row2 col3: FOREARM SEGMENT ONLY, fluffy rounded capsule, hanging vertical.
row3 col1: LEFT PAW only, rounded small soft stuffed pink paw.
row3 col2: RIGHT PAW only, same pile.
row3 col3: ONE FOOT only, pink stuffed outer fur with pale ivory toe/underside like the actual plush, front three-quarter view.
All parts made for the exact same character and lighting. Face is recognizably the reference, not a teddy bear, no accessories, no whiskers, no eyelashes, no eyebrows, no claws, no stylized animal pads. True transparent background, no matte rectangles.
prompts.clearing:
Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL premium hand-painted cinematic storybook environment matte painting for a 2.5D interactive film for Valerie, a tender private gift. No text, no UI, no characters or animals, no boxes, no hearts, no particles. Wide landscape format approx 3:2, high detail. A miniature enchanted woodland among old vineyard trees at blue hour. Painterly oil-gouache realism with fine brush texture, tangible bark, velvety moss, huge graceful arching vine branches and delicate grape leaves creating a natural proscenium, an intimate luminous clearing at center. A shallow clear stream crosses the lower middle left to right, smooth oval stones form a tiny walkable crossing, fern banks, a large worn moss-covered stump just RIGHT of center behind the crossing. The stump must be physically integrated and its top clear to place a gift later. Distant luminous warm peach dusk opening framed by deep muted petrol and sage trees, small moon very faint, restrained romantic palette: warm ivory light, desaturated blue-green shadows, muted rose reflected in water. Ground is lush, not a stage/platform. No buildings or fantasy castles. Make the scene feel like a lovingly illustrated children's film with mature cinematic lighting and meticulous natural detail, not a flat vector illustration. 
Composition for mobile AND desktop: quiet open stage in center 65% width from 30% to 80% height, lower foreground dark ferns at the extreme side corners only; no objects occluding future character faces in center. Stump top around image x62%, y57%; crossing around y73%. Strong foreground/midground/distance separation. Graceful asymmetry, branches frame rather than divide the image. The entire painting will be panned and viewed at different lenses, so edge regions should also be complete and beautiful. Sharp rich illustration, not a blurred photographic background. All light is physically placed; no giant glow blobs.
prompts.gift:
Use case: illustration-story / precise-object-edit. The two reference images show the SAME real gift box. Create one ORIGINAL illustrated production asset of that actual gift box, not a screenshot. Faithfully keep its warm blush pink rigid rectangular cardboard gift-case proportions, BLACK thin piping all around the outer edges and seams, a tall hinged upright lid, and small warm-white string lights following the inner edges. This is a LARGE RECTANGULAR GIFT BOX for two plush animals, NOT a tiny ring box, NOT a jewelry box, NOT a velvet or leather chest, no invented latch or gold hardware. Use the photos for identity/materials, not their camera quality. Remove the plush toys and every other object from inside the box so it is empty. Preserve the dark small pennant strings across the inside lid, but leave the pennants BLANK, absolutely NO letters or words because the final question must not be revealed yet.
Art direction: delicate high-detail painterly textile-and-paper realism, gently worn paper edges, pink cardboard panels with subtle warm reflections, restrained gouache brushwork, warm interior lights and cool blue-hour exterior shading. Elegant, tactile, intimate. 
Output a SQUARE transparent PNG atlas with TWO complete isolated views arranged one above the other in equal top and bottom halves separated by generous transparent space:
TOP HALF: the same large gift box CLOSED, three-quarter front view slightly from above; a broad rectangular top and substantial box side walls, very fine black edging. No ribbons or bows unless visible in reference (they aren't).
BOTTOM HALF: the same gift box OPEN, three-quarter frontal view with tall lid upright at about 105 degrees; empty pink interior and warm lights on inner edges, dark BLANK pennants. Keep the whole lid and box in frame. No toys, no ring, no flowers, no surface beneath the box and no backdrop. The closed and open views must unmistakably be the same real gift.
No text, labels, grid, numbers, symbols or decorative sparkles. True transparent background.
prompts.foliage:
Use case: illustration-story. Production 2.5D scenery pieces for the SAME miniature vineyard woodland film: painterly oil/gouache realism with tactile old bark, moss, sage grape leaves, subtle warm dusk rim light and deep petrol shadows. No characters, text, animals, gift boxes or particles. One square transparent PNG atlas with four fully separate assets, generous transparent gutters, NO labels/grid. Precisely two columns and two rows:
TOP LEFT: one tall gnarled vine-tree side trunk, roots at bottom, graceful curving trunk along the LEFT edge of its asset and branches reaching inward/right at top with hanging grape leaves and a few dark grape bunches; open empty space to its right. Natural slender framing branch, not a solid green rectangular mass.
TOP RIGHT: corresponding RIGHT side vine-tree trunk, branches reaching inward/left at top. Different irregular anatomy but same material.
BOTTOM LEFT: a low fan-shaped cluster of lush dark ferns, tiny moss-covered stones and a few small sage leaves, detached isolated foreground bank, much wider than tall, no ground rectangle.
BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE large heart-shaped woodland leaf seen from front, strong fine vein detail, sage/olive translucent leaf blade, slightly irregular fuzzy edge; pointed tip at top and short narrow stem attachment at bottom. It will act as a leaf-door lifted by a puppet's hand, so must be completely isolated and not overlap any other asset.
Keep all four objects inside their own cells with wide empty transparent margins and no overlapping between cells. Genuine transparent background, no matte, no smoke, no vignette behind objects, no cast shadow beyond individual silhouettes. High-quality foliage, beautifully handmade illustration that can be enlarged on a phone.
